pending_ideas.hook: Woman flips a worn laundry basket upside-down into a wide concrete-filled basin, pressing it down until it disappears completely underwater.
pending_ideas.why: Tier 1 water feature with the instant confusion of submerging a recognizable household object that looks ruined but becomes a lattice-textured basin - the umbrella fountain proved this format at 95k views.
pending_ideas.tr: Eski çamaşır sepetini beton havuzuna bastırıp kuş banyosu yapıyorum.

pending_ideas.hook: Woman lowers a cracked storage bin into a concrete-lined pit, then pours wet cement over the entire thing until only bubbles escape.
pending_ideas.why: Tier 1 scale and water, hitting the kiddie-pool format (644k views) with a different household object - the burial moment creates the irreversible-looking middle that correlates with retention.
pending_ideas.tr: Kırık plastik kutuyu betonla kaplayıp bahçe su çanağı yapıyorum.

pending_ideas.hook: Woman dunks a muddy rubber boot into a bucket of cement, coating it completely while the sole and buckles stay visible through the wet surface.
pending_ideas.why: Tier 2 recognizable worn object keeping boot detail (sole tread, buckles) like successful garment videos at 18-29k views, but boots are visually distinct from jeans/overalls/shoes already done.
pending_ideas.tr: Eski lastik çizmeleri betona batırıp saksı yapıyorum.

pending_ideas.hook: Woman pours thick cement directly into a frayed wicker basket, filling it while the weave pattern bulges and darkens, looking destroyed.
pending_ideas.why: Tier 2 with intricate detail preservation - the basket weave becoming readable in stone mirrors the straw hat success (29k views) but delivers a functional planter payoff instead of decoration.
pending_ideas.tr: Hasır sepeti betonla dolduruyorum, örme desen taş saksı oluyor.

pending_ideas.hook: Woman submerges a kitchen colander into cement, liquid pouring through every hole, then lifts it out dripping with concrete stalactites hanging from the bottom.
pending_ideas.why: Tier 2 household recognition with dramatic middle - cement pouring through holes looks like failure but the perforated stone result is garden-functional, avoiding the low performance of from-scratch builds.
pending_ideas.tr: Mutfak süzgecini betona batırıp delikli taş kase yapıyorum.
